description.before: Single-arm mobile manipulator announced April 17, 2026 for light-duty, human-in-the-loop work. AGIBOT describes 7 DOF, a 750–800 mm manipulator reach, a footprint under 800 mm wide and zero-radius turning. Task execution and data capture share a workflow, using a UMI-isomorphic layout. Assisted operation and a planned path toward more autonomy are distinct from proven unsupervised deployment.
description.after: G2 Air is a compact single-arm mobile manipulator announced April 17, 2026 for light-duty human-in-the-loop operations. The manufacturer release lists seven manipulator DOF, three-kilogram payload, 750–800 mm reach, width under 800 mm and speeds of at least 1.5 m/s. A UMI-isomorphic layout combines task execution with data capture. The proposed transition from assisted work to full autonomy is a roadmap, not proof of unsupervised operation.

handType.after: Dexterous hand; detailed configuration not established

description.before: Interactive full-size humanoid for reception and service tasks.
description.after: A2 is the named interactive service humanoid for reception, exhibition guidance and business inquiries. Its current dedicated page lists 169 cm height, 69 kg, a 700 Wh battery, two-hour runtime and 40+ active DOF. It combines LiDAR, RGB-D/fisheye sensing and dialogue customization. This A2 page is kept distinct from A2 Ultra/Lite and the legacy A2-W identity.

description.before: Open-source 1.3 m / 33 kg modular humanoid, 34 DOF, 3.6 km/h, ~2 h battery, PowerFlow joints
description.after: X1, retained under the catalog name Lingxi X1, is a modular open-source humanoid platform for development. Its dedicated page lists 130 cm height, 33 kg, 34 active DOF, a 0.5 kg load per arm, two-hour runtime and maximum 1 m/s walking speed. PowerFlow actuators, controllers and an adaptive gripper are component ecosystem entries rather than additional complete X1 robots.

description.before: 1.31 m / ~35 kg interactive biped, up to 30 DOF, 2 m/s, 500 Wh battery ~2 h, rides bikes
description.after: The catalog Lingxi X2 entry represents current base X2 specifications, rather than a mixture of X2 variants. The brochure lists 131 cm height, 35 kg, 25 total DOF, five per arm, a 3 kg maximum end-effector payload and two-hour 500 Wh endurance. The series page explicitly excludes Ultra navigation and obstacle-avoidance features from base X2. Historic Lingxi naming does not establish identical specifications across revisions.

description.before: Wheeled data-collection humanoid, 130-180 cm lift, 150 kg, 26 DOF, 3 kg/arm, 4+ h battery
description.after: G1, retained under catalog name Genie G1, is a wheeled data-collection and model-inference platform. Its current page lists 150 kg, 130–180 cm adjustable height, 70 cm span, Jetson AGX Orin 64GB and over four hours runtime. The table states 20 DOF excluding the end effector while prose states 26 total without a complete counting breakdown; both scopes remain explicit. VR capture, force sensors and multiple cameras support data acquisition.

description.before: Industrial-grade wheeled embodied operation robot for quality inspection and assembly; automotive-grade components, IP42 protection, sub-millimeter force-control operation and Genie RL deployment.
description.after: G2 is a wheeled industrial manipulation platform with 26 DOF excluding end effectors, torque-sensed seven-DOF arms and five-kilogram rated load per arm. The brochure lists maximum 1.5 m/s movement and four-steering-wheel mobility supporting Ackermann steering, in-place rotation and lateral motion. The page explicitly rates the full machine IP42. Dual-battery hot swapping, autonomous charging and Genie RL support integrated workflows without establishing a fixed battery-only runtime.

handType.after: Advanced OmniHand; brochure describes up to 20 DOF per hand

description.before: Full-size humanoid platform unveiled by AGIBOT at WAIC 2026.
description.after: A3 Ultra is a 174 cm, 60 kg commercial humanoid announced at WAIC on July 18, 2026. Its model announcement specifies 51 active DOF, five-kilogram payload per arm and up to eight hours combined operation. The brochure describes UWB/RTK positioning, LiDAR/camera sensing, autonomous plug-in charging and ten-second battery swapping. A3 base specifications of 55 kg and ten hours do not transfer to Ultra.

payload.after: Up to 40 kg combined dual-arm handling

description.before: Industrial embodied robot unveiled by AGIBOT at WAIC 2026 for demanding task execution.
description.after: G2 Max is a heavy-duty force-controlled industrial robot announced at WAIC in July 2026 and formally launched on October 29, 2026. The latter release specifies 21 DOF, up to 40 kg dual-arm handling capacity and an adjustable working height of 0.1–2.5 m. Omnidirectional wheeled mobility supports handling and pallet-related applications. Combined load is not a per-arm rating; whole-body mass, battery endurance and charge duration remain unestablished.

batteryLife.after: Up to 10 h; dual battery configuration

description.before: Full-size AGIBOT humanoid platform also referred to as Expedition A3. The base A3 is distinct from A3 Ultra; published specifications include 173 cm height, 55 kg weight and 10-hour endurance.
description.after: A3 is the full-size 173 cm, 55 kg performance humanoid launched in 2026. The manufacturer brochure lists a dual-battery configuration labelled 1152 Wh, up-to-ten-hour endurance, hot swapping and fleet choreography for over 100 robots. UWB positioning and LinkCraft motion creation support coordinated performances. Whole-body DOF, exact arm payload and charging duration are not established by the selected text.

highlights: Industrial embodied-operation platform with manufacturer-stated IP42 protection
Force-controlled operation and Genie RL are positioned for assembly and deployment
Interaction features include expressive animations, multi-user conversation and gaze tracking
